{{NSE|RAMCOSYS}} | num_locations = 30 offices | key_people = * PR Venketrama Raja (Chairman) * Abinav Raja (Managing Director) * Sandesh Bilagi (CEO) {{cite web |title=Ramco Systems appoints Sandesh Bilagi as Chief Executive Officer |publisher=National Stock Exchange of India |date=2 July 2026 |url=https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/RAMCOSYS_02072026195354_02072026PressReleaseCEOAppointment.pdf |access-date=3 July 2026 }} | industry = [[Enterprise software]] | products = *Global Payroll Software *Aviation Software *ERP *Logistics Software | revenue = US$61.79 million | revenue_year = 2023 (March) [https://www.ramco.com/hubfs/investor-relations/QucikResult-31-03-2023.pdf Ramco.com Investor Relations – QucikResult 31 March 2023] (PDF) | num_employees = 1801+ | parent = [[Ramco Group]] | founded = 1997{{Cite web|url=http://www.ramco.com/about/index.aspx|title=Ramco Systems - About Us - HCM on Cloud | ERP on Cloud | Aviation Software|access-date=26 September 2012|archive-date=9 October 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121009145558/http://www.ramco.com/about/index.aspx|url-status=live}} | hq_location = [[Chennai]], India | website = {{URL|http://www.ramco.com/}} }} '''Ramco Systems Limited''' is an Indian multinational [[enterprise software]] product & platform provider.{{Cite web |date=2013-01-19 |title=Ramco to battle global turf on cloud |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/ramco-to-battle-global-turf-on-cloud-112052100016_1.html |website=Business Standard}} Founded in 1997, it is a part of the Ramco Group, and is headquartered in [[Chennai]], India. == History == Ramco Systems was founded in 1992 as the research and development division of Ramco Industries and began product development in 1993. It became a separate subsidiary in 1997.{{Cite web|title=Ramco Systems: Will the IT major make it big?|url=https://www.businesstoday.in/magazine/case-study/story/ramco-systems-would-the-it-major-make-it-big-28184-2012-02-18|access-date=2022-02-22|website=Business Today|date=18 February 2012|archive-date=22 February 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220222214218/https://www.businesstoday.in/magazine/case-study/story/ramco-systems-would-the-it-major-make-it-big-28184-2012-02-18|url-status=live}} In the same year, the company released its [[Enterprise resource planning|ERP]] product, ''Marshal 3.0'', which was launched by [[Bill Gates]]. In 2002, Ramco Systems launched ''VirtualWorks'', a web-based ERP product that automates [[software development]]. In 2011, the company launched its [[Software as a service|SaaS]] ERP service for the [[aviation]], [[aerospace]] and [[Arms industry|defense industries]].{{Cite web |last=D'Amore |first=Dino |date=2011-04-13 |title=Ramco Systems Launches SAAS ERP for Aviation Manufacturing |url=https://www.mroglobal-online.com/ramco-systems-launches-saas-erp-for-aviation-manufacturing/ |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230903133914/https://www.mroglobal-online.com/ramco-systems-launches-saas-erp-for-aviation-manufacturing/ |archive-date=3 September 2023 |access-date=2023-09-03 |website=MRO Global}} In 2014, Ramco Systems signed a deal with [[Norske Skog]] to provide Cloud enterprise resource planning (ERP) integrated with asset management and financials for its ANZ region.{{Cite news |date=2014-05-28 |title=Ramco to provide cloud solution to Norske Skog across ANZ region |work=The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/ites/ramco-to-provide-cloud-solution-to-norske-skog-across-anz-region/articleshow/35680954.cms |access-date=2023-09-03 |issn=0013-0389}} In 2016, Ramco Systems opened an engineering lab in [[Singapore]]. The lab's first anchor partner was Air France Industries ''KLM Engineering & Maintenance'', for whom it advanced aviation IT solutions, along with [[Wearable computer|wearables]] for ground engineers and drones to inspect aircraft on the tarmac. With support from [[Economic Development Board|Singapore Economic Development Board]] (EDB).{{Cite news |last=Elizabeth |first=Shilpa |date=2016-02-18 |title=Ramco Systems opens innovation lab in Singapore |work=The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/ites/ramco-systems-opens-innovation-lab-in-singapore/articleshow/51041105.cms |access-date=2023-09-03 |issn=0013-0389}} In 2022, Ramco Systems established a new development center in [[Madurai]], which was the company's first product development center outside of its headquarters in [[Chennai]].{{Cite web |date=2022-05-30 |title=Ramco Systems looks to tap Madurai's tech talent |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/ramco-systems-looks-to-tap-madurais-tech-talent/articleshow/91842704.cms |website=India Times}} In the same year, the company also opened a new subsidiary in the United States called ''Ramco Systems Defense'' and Security Incorporated (RSDSI).{{Cite web |title=Ramco Systems opens new offices in US |url=https://www.devdiscourse.com/article/law-order/2132418-ramco-systems-opens-new-offices-in-us |access-date=2023-09-03 |website=Devdiscourse}} RSDSI is focused on the defense industry in the United States. ''Ramco Systems Defense'' has offices in [[Washington, D.C.]] and [[Dallas]]. In 2023, [[Etihad Airways]] Engineering partnered with Ramco to implement Ramco's Aviation Suite V5.9.{{Cite web |date=2023-03-02 |title=Etihad Airways Engineering Partners with Ramco Systems |url=https://www.aviationpros.com/aircraft/maintenance-providers/mro/press-release/53027240/ramco-systems-etihad-airways-engineering-partners-with-ramco-systems |access-date=2023-08-06 |website=Aviation Pros}} Also in 2023, Ramco Systems inaugurated its wholly owned subsidiary in [[Qatar]] to work with the region's businesses on ERP, HR, and payroll software.{{Cite web |date=2023-06-05 |title=Ramco Systems' shares gain 4% as it strengthens presence in the Middle East |url=https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/ramco-systems-share-price-gains-over-4-as-it-strengthens-presence-in-the-middle-east-11685939405054.html |access-date=2023-09-03 |website=mint}} In the same year, Ramco Systems appointed its current chief executive officer, Sundar Subramanian.{{Cite web |last=Kumari |first=Jagriti |date=2023-07-04 |title=Ramco Systems names Sundar Subramanian as CEO |url=https://www.peoplematters.in/news/appointments/ramco-systems-names-sundar-subramanian-as-ceo-38324 |access-date=2023-09-03 |website=People Matters}} == Products and services == === Global Payroll Software === Ramco Systems’ HR and payroll software includes artificial intelligence-based solutions for HR and payroll,{{Cite web |date=2018-08-29 |title=Microsoft Embeds AI Into New Payroll Solution |url=https://www.pymnts.com/news/b2b-payments/2018/microsoft-payroll-ramco-partnership-hr-software-solutions/ |access-date=2023-10-14 |website=PYMNTS}} such as its Self Explaining Payslip (SEP) system launched in 2021, which handles employee payroll queries using automated responses.{{Cite web |last=Simhan |first=TE Raja |date=2021-07-09 |title=Ramco Systems develops self explaining payslip |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/info-tech/ramco-systems-develops-self-explaining-payslip/article35230695.ece |access-date=2023-09-03 |website=BusinessLine }} Ramco Systems also partnered with [[Microsoft]] to launch Ramco Global Payroll Software on [[Microsoft Dynamics 365]] in 2018.{{Cite web |date=2018-08-29 |title=Microsoft partners with Ramco Payroll |url=https://www.enterprisetimes.co.uk/2018/08/29/microsoft-partners-with-ramco-for-payroll-offering/ |url-status= |website=Enterprise Times}} In 2021, Ramco Systems signed a partnership with the two largest HCM providers, [[Oracle Corporation|Oracle]] and [[Workday, Inc.|Workday]].[https://www.newindianexpress.com/cities/chennai/2021/Apr/21/payroll-solution-by-ramco-now-on-oracle-cloud-marketplace-2292625.html "Payroll solution by Ramco now on Oracle Cloud Marketplace"]. 21 April 2021. Retrieved 4 November 2025.{{Cite web |date=2023-03-27 |title=Should Ramco Systems be in your portfolio? A research summary of the stock |url=https://alphastreet.com/india/should-ramco-systems-be-in-your-portfolio-a-research-summary-of-the-stock/ |access-date=2023-11-27 |website=AlphaStreet}} The partnership allowed Ramco to provide multi-country payroll to Workday's MNC client base. In the same year, it announced the launch of its Global Payroll solution on the Oracle Cloud Marketplace.{{Cite web |last=Region |first=Theme |title=Ramco Global Payroll Forays into Oracle Cloud Marketplace |url=https://www.cioinsiderindia.com/news/ramco-global-payroll-forays-into-oracle-cloud-marketplace-nwid-2702.html |access-date=2023-11-27 |website=CIO Insider India}} In a collaborative effort, Ramco Systems has integrated its comprehensive payroll platform, with Oracle Fusion Cloud Human Capital Management (HCM). In 2022, Ramco Systems formed a partnership with the Australian financial technology company Wagestream, which allowed employees to track their financial statistics through a single platform.{{Cite web |last= |first= |date=2022-10-21 |title=Ramco Systems ties up with Wagestream |url=https://www.dtnext.in/business/2022/10/21/ramco-systems-ties-up-with-wagestream-2 |access-date=2023-11-27 |website=DT Next}} In the same year, it  also began implementing its payroll and HR solutions at Kudu Company for Food and Catering, a Saudi Arabian restaurant chain.{{Cite web |last=Simhan |first=TE Raja |date=2022-07-20 |title=Ramco Systems to implement Payroll & HR Solution at Kudu in Saudi Arabia |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/ramco-systems-to-implement-its-payroll-hr-solution-at-kudu-company-in-saudi-arabia/article65661350.ece |access-date=2023-11-27 |website=BusinessLine |language=en}} In February 2023, Ramco Systems launched Payce, a platform-based payroll software.{{Cite web |date=2024-02-09 |title=Ramco Systems launches new payroll platform, bets on it to grow quicker and reverse losses |url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/business/companies/ramco-systems-launches-new-payroll-platform-bets-on-it-to-grow-quicker-and-reverse-losses-19016691.htm |access-date=2024-09-21 |website=CNBC TV18}} In November 2023, Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP partnered with Ramco Systems to combine Ramco's payroll solution with Deloitte's advisory and managed services.{{Cite web |date=November 29, 2023 |title=Deloitte India partners with Ramco Systems to revolutionise payroll services |url=https://cfotech.in/story/deloitte-india-partners-with-ramco-systems-to-revolutionise-payroll-services |website=CFOtech}}{{Cite web |date=2023-11-29 |title=Deloitte India, Ramco Systems partner to transform payroll services |url=https://www.techcircle.in/2023/11/29/deloitte-india-ramco-systems-partner-to-transform-payroll-services |access-date=2024-09-21 |website=Techcircle |language=en}}  In January 2024, Ramco Systems partnered with BDO India LLP, a professional services organization in India to serve as the technology platform provider for BDO India’s payroll and managed services.{{Cite web |date=2024-01-22 |title=Ramco Systems Partners with BDO India |url=https://martechvibe.com/article/ramco-systems-partners-with-bdo-india/ |access-date=2024-09-21 |website=Martechvibe |language=en}} === Aviation software === Ramco Systems provides aviation maintenance software for civil and defense clients. Ramco Systems’ ERP products such as its Aviation ERP also make use of [[artificial intelligence]] and [[machine learning]].{{Cite web |last=Ramarathinam |first=Ashwin |date=2021-05-27 |title=Ramco Systems surges 5% as Iraqi Airways decides to adopt its aviation software |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/ramco-systems-surges-5-as-iraqi-airways-decides-to-adopt-its-aviation-software-11622098622201.html |access-date=2023-12-27 |website=mint |language=en}} Its aviation software was also adopted by [[Iraqi Airways]] in the year 2021. Ramco Systems began supplying version 5.9 of its aviation maintenance and engineering suite to [[General Atomics Aeronautical Systems]] for use in its SkyGuardian Global Support Solutions program in 2022.{{Cite news |date=2022-09-02 |title=Ramco Systems Defense to provide Aviation M&E suite to GA-ASI |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/transportation/airlines-/-aviation/ramco-systems-defense-to-provide-aviation-me-suite-to-ga-asi/articleshow/93951656.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2023-10-14 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}} In 2023, [[Etihad Airways]] announced that it would also be implementing Ramco Systems’ Aviation Suite V5.9 at the MRO Middle East conference.{{Cite web |last= |first= |date=2023-03-02 |title=Etihad Airways Engineering partners with Ramco Systems |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/economy/logistics/etihad-airways-engineering-partners-with-ramco-systems/article66572354.ece |access-date=2023-12-27 |website=BusinessLine |publisher=BL Chennai Bureau}} [[Philippine Airlines]] joined Etihad Airways in using Aviation Suite V5.9 in the same year.{{Cite web |date=2023-02-15 |title=Ramco Systems to offer Aviation Suite V5.9 for Philippine Airlines |url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/aviation/ramco-systems-to-offer-aviation-suite-v59-for-philippine-airlines-15946091.htm |access-date=2023-12-27 |website=CNBCTV18 |language=en}} In the same year, they also signed a deal with Australian technology company [[Nuova Systems, Inc.|Nova Systems]] to develop [[material resource planning]] (MRP) software for Nova Systems.{{Cite web |date=2023-02-07 |title=Ramco Systems signs software deal with Australia-based Nova Systems for Aviation M&E MRO Suite |url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/stocks/ramco-systems-australia-deal-nova-systems-mrp-software-selection-15876501.htm |access-date=2023-12-27 |website=CNBCTV18 |language=en}} In the same year, Ramco Systems entered a strategic partnership with Airbus Helicopters SAS to develop an MIS Data Pack Connector.{{Cite web |title=CASE STUDY: An ERP system that has grown with Airbus New Zealand |url=https://www.aircraftit.com/articles/case-study-an-erp-system-that-has-grown-with-airbus-new-zealand/ |access-date=2024-09-21 |website=Aircraft IT}} In April 2024, [[Korean Air]] announced that it was collaborating with Ramco Aviation to implement Ramco Aviation Suite at Korean Air’s Engine Maintenance Center.{{Cite web |date=April 12, 2024 |title=Ramco Systems shares jump another 13.5% to hit 2-year high, up 44% in April so far – what's behind the rally? |url=https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/ramco-systems-shares-jump-another-13-5-to-hit-2-year-high-up-44-in-april-so-far-whats-behind-the-rally-11712902244534.html |website=livemint.com}} In March 2026, Ramco Systems announced that the [[Tata Advanced Systems Limited]] (TASL) has selected its aviation MRO software for the MRO facility that is under construction to support the [[C-130J Super Hercules]] fleet of the [[Indian Air Force]]. The software will manage all aspects of the facility's operation, including contract and quote management, maintenance planning, hangar and component maintenance, supply chain management, engineering and quality, as well as customer billing.{{Cite news |date=2026-03-10 |title=Tata Advanced Systems taps Ramco to power digital backbone of IAF C-130J MRO facility |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/defence/tata-advanced-systems-taps-ramco-to-power-digital-backbone-of-iaf-c-130j-mro-facility/articleshow/129377749.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2026-03-10 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}} === ERP === Ramco Systems also develops enterprise resource planning software that allows users to manage functions such as supply chain/logistics planning, finance management, and [[human resources management]].{{Cite web |last=McKenna |first=James T. |date=2017-09-06 |title=New Saudi MRO Goes Live With Ramco ERP Suite |url=https://www.aviationtoday.com/2017/09/06/new-saudi-mro-goes-live-ramco-erp-suite/ |access-date=2023-10-14 |website=Avionics International |language=en}} === Logistics Software === Ramco Systems’ logistics software includes [[Cloud computing|cloud-based solutions]] for [[Warehouse management system|warehouse management]] and transportation, and fleet management for third party logistics and express parcel provider.{{Cite web |last= |date=2016-01-27 |title=Ramco Systems in Logistics Software deal with AAI Worldwide |url=https://infotechlead.com/software/ramco-systems-logistics-software-deal-aai-worldwide-38035 |access-date=2023-10-14 |website=InfotechLead |language=en-US}} It also provides end-to-end services for 3PLs, e-commerce logistics providers, and other businesses that use analytics and artificial intelligence.{{Cite web |date=2020-09-28 |title=A Storehouse of Innovation—WMS for E-Commerce |url=https://www.inboundlogistics.com/articles/a-storehouse-of-innovation-wms-for-e-commerce/ |access-date=2023-11-27 |website=Inbound Logistics |language=en}} In 2023, Ramco Systems implemented its Logistics ERP Software at Freight Specialists, a freight and distribution services provider based in Sydney, Australia, to automate company-wide operations and services.{{Cite web |date=2023-11-23 |title=Freight Specialists quietly reshaping the landscape |url=https://bigrigs.com.au/2023/11/23/freight-specialists-quietly-reshaping-the-landscape/ |access-date=2024-09-21 |website=Big Rigs |language=en-US}}  === RAMCO CHIA === Ramco CHIA is a virtual assistant that uses artificial intelligence features such as deep learning and natural language processing for HR transactions.{{Cite web |date=2021-02-01 |title=Ramco Systems launches its Virtual Assistant CHIA on Signal and Telegram |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-cm/ramco-systems-launches-its-virtual-assistant-chia-on-signal-and-telegram-121020100489_1.html |website=Business Standard}} === RamcoGEEK === Ramco Systems has also released a facial attendance system called RamcoGEEK, which used facial recognition technology and temperature recording to create a "touch-less" workplace attendance for use during the [[COVID-19 pandemic]].{{Cite web |date=2020-03-18 |title=Coronavirus: Ramco Systems launches new attendance system with face recognition, temperature screening |url=https://tech.hindustantimes.com/tech/news/coronavirus-ramco-systems-launches-new-attendance-system-with-face-recognition-temperature-screening-story-o2lQFMnKj0R0PK4bJ98T7K.html |access-date=2023-11-27 |website=HT Tech |language=en}} === Microsoft collaborations === Ramco Systems has partnered with Microsoft on products such as Ramco Global Payroll Software, which is integrated with [[Microsoft Dynamics 365]] for Talent. It has also used Microsoft's cloud platform for its cloud computing and Microsoft's Cloud AI platform for artificial intelligence, such as Chia, Ramco Systems’ chatbot which uses Microsoft Luis. == Locations == The company has locations in several countries, including: United States, China, Canada, Australia, Philippines, Indonesia, India and South America.{{Cite web |last=Simhan |first=TE Raja |date=2022-06-14 |title=Ramco Systems: 'Our immediate goal is a $100-mn order book this fiscal' |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/info-tech/ramco-systems-our-immediate-goal-is-a-100-mn-order-book-this-fiscal/article65525063.ece |access-date=2023-11-27 |website=BusinessLine |language=en}}{{Cite web |title=Ramco Systems Limited: Locations |url=https://www.globaldata.com/company-profile/ramco-systems-limited/locations/ |access-date=2023-11-27 |website=GlobalData}} ==See also== *[[List of ERP vendors]] ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== * {{Official website|http://www.ramco.com/}} {{Ramco Group}} [[Category:Information technology companies of India]] [[Category:Customer relationship management software companies]] [[Category:ERP software companies]] [[Category:Companies based in Chennai]] [[Category:Software companies established in 1992]] [[Category:Indian brands]] [[Category:1992 establishments in Tamil Nadu]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] [[Category:Multinational companies headquartered in India]] [[Category:Payroll]]
extract: Ramco Systems Limited is an Indian multinational enterprise software product & platform provider. Founded in 1997, it is a part of the Ramco Group, and is headquartered in Chennai, India.
